items.stem: Define the term "customer relationship management (CRM)".
items.answer: The strategies and systems used to build long-term relationships with customers

items.answer: All businesses benefit; even low-cost firms lose customers when service is poor, and service can differentiate firms in competitive markets.

items.stem: Explain the difference between customer relationship management and customer service.
items.answer: Customer service is the help given during each interaction; CRM is the long-term strategy and systems for building relationships and loyalty across many interactions.

items.stem: A passport office has 5 service points, and each customer takes 2 minutes to serve. At peak time 40 customers arrive per hour. Calculate the maximum number of customers that can be served per hour and the utilisation of service capacity, and comment on the likely customer experience.
